IEcommercePlatformProduct.IRequest.description:
Search and filter parameters for listing products on the ecommerce platform.

This request body supports product browsing with multiple optional filters including text search on product name, category filtering, seller filtering, price range filtering, and availability status control. Products without active variants are excluded by default but can be included by setting the includeUnavailable parameter to true. Results can be sorted by name, price, or creation/update timestamps. Pagination is supported via offset-based pagination using offset and limit parameters, or page-based navigation using the page parameter.
IEcommercePlatformProduct.IRequest.x-autobe-specification:
Request DTO for PATCH /ecommercePlatform/products product listing endpoint. All properties are optional query parameters that construct WHERE clauses, JOINs, ORDER BY, and pagination logic against the ecommerce_platform_products table.

Query construction rules:
- Base query: SELECT from ecommerce_platform_products WHERE deleted_at IS NULL (always excludes soft-deleted products)
- productName: Trigram-based GIN index text search on name column for partial/fuzzy matching
- categoryId: Exact match filter on ecommerce_platform_category_id FK; supports both root categories and subcategories
- sellerProfileId: Exact match filter on ecommerce_platform_seller_profile_id FK
- minBasePrice: Lower bound inclusive filter on base_price (>=), minimum value 0
- maxBasePrice: Upper bound inclusive filter on base_price (<=), minimum value 0
- includeUnavailable: When false/null (default), adds EXISTS subquery on ecommerce_platform_product_variants WHERE deleted_at IS NULL to exclude products with no active variants; when true, all active products are returned
- sortField: Maps to ORDER BY column: name->name, basePrice->base_price, createdAt->created_at, updatedAt->updated_at; defaults to createdAt
- sortOrder: Ascending/descending modifier (asc/desc); defaults to desc
- limit: Max rows returned (1-100, max 100); defaults to 20
- offset: Rows to skip; defaults to 0
- page: 1-indexed page alternative to offset; calculates offset as (page-1)*limit; defaults to 1

IEcommercePlatformProductVariant.description:
Represents a specific purchasable configuration of a product with a unique SKU code and optional price override.

Product variants define characteristics such as color, size, or material combinations that differentiate specific product configurations. Each variant maintains its stock quantity through an immutable inventory ledger tracking all additions and deductions. When no variant-specific price is set, the product's base price applies.

Variant option attributes are stored as key-value pairs defining the variant's specific characteristics. Current stock is computed by summing all inventory record changes for this variant, providing a complete audit trail of stock movements including restocking events and order fulfillments.
IEcommercePlatformProductVariant.x-autobe-specification:
Maps ecommerce_platform_product_variants table: id (UUID), sku_code (String), price (nullable Float), created_at, updated_at, deleted_at (nullable DateTime).

BELONGS-TO: product relationship via ecommerce_platform_product_id FK → IEcommercePlatformProduct.ISummary for category and shop context.

HAS-MANY: options composition from ecommerce_platform_product_variant_options loaded as array of IEcommercePlatformProductVariantOption entities.

Computed aggregation: stock_quantity derived from SUM(quantity_change) on ecommerce_platform_inventory_records WHERE product_variant_id matches this variant's id.

All temporal fields included for audit trail. Options ordered by attribute_key alphabetically for consistent response structure.

quantity.description:
The number of units of the product variant to retain in the cart.

Must be a positive integer greater than or equal to 1. Updating this field adjusts the line item quantity. To remove an item entirely, use the DELETE endpoint instead. Customer ownership and product variant references are immutable after creation; only the quantity is mutable.
quantity.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to ecommerce_platform_shopping_cart_items.quantity. Positive integer >= 1. Mutable field updated via this endpoint; product variant and customer ownership references are immutable. Reject updates if quantity < 1. Subtotal recalculated at query time using the new quantity multiplied by the variant's current price.

IEcommercePlatformShoppingCartItem.IUpda.description:
Update request payload to modify the quantity of a shopping cart item.

Contains only the mutable quantity field, which must be a positive integer greater than or equal to 1. This payload adjusts the number of units of a product variant the authenticated customer wishes to retain in their cart. Customer ownership, the target product variant, and system-managed fields are immutable and cannot be provided in the request body.
IEcommercePlatformShoppingCartItem.IUpda.x-autobe-specification: Update DTO for shopping cart items allowing customers to modify only the positive integer quantity (>= 1) of a specific cart item. Structural identity (id, customer_id, product_variant_id), system timestamps (created_at, updated_at, deleted_at), and entity relations (customer, productVariant) are immutable and excluded as user-provided fields. Ownership is verified against the authenticated customer's JWT session. Returns 404 if the cart item has been soft-deleted (deleted_at IS NOT NULL).

IEcommercePlatformCategory.description:
Complete category entity representing a product classification on the ecommerce platform, supporting a two-level hierarchy structure.

Categories organize products into root categories and subcategories. Root categories define primary classifications without a parent, while subcategories refine these primary groups. The system enforces a strict one-level nesting limit, preventing subcategories from creating their own subcategories to maintain a flat and browseable catalog structure.

Unique name constraints ensure clarity within each hierarchy level, requiring siblings to have distinct names. Soft deletion capabilities via the `deleted_at` field allow administrators to remove categories for cleanup without destructive impacts on historical order data and product listings.
IEcommercePlatformCategory.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from `ecommerce_platform_categories` table, including all columns and self-referential relations (`parentCategory`, `childrenCategories`). The `products` relation and raw `parent_ecommerce_platform_category_id` column are excluded as products belong to separate dedicated endpoints and the FK column is exposed via the `parentCategory` relation object.

sku_code.description:
Optional filter to narrow variant snapshot results by SKU code.

Accepts exact SKU code matching or partial substring matching against historical variant identifiers. Useful for auditing specific variant configurations across time. Leave empty or omit to retrieve all SKU codes in the result set.
sku_code.x-autobe-specification:
Server-side filter against ecommerce_platform_snapshot_variants.sku_code column. Supports exact match when full SKU code provided, or partial substring match when abbreviated text supplied. No type transformation required.

Examples: 'SKU-12345' (exact match), 'SKU-123' (partial match matching any code containing this substring)

price.description:
Optional filter to narrow variant snapshot results by exact price value.

Requires exact price match (double-precision floating-point) against the price recorded at snapshot time. Useful for auditing pricing history or identifying snapshots at specific price points. Omit this filter to retrieve snapshots at all price levels.
price.x-autobe-specification:
Server-side filter against ecommerce_platform_snapshot_variants.price column. Exact double-precision floating-point match — snapshots must have price exactly equal to the provided value. Accepts null check by omitting filter.

No rounding or approximate matching applied. Example: filtering price=29.99 returns only snapshots recorded at precisely $29.99.

stock_quantity.description:
Optional filter to narrow variant snapshot results by exact stock quantity.

Requires precise integer match against inventory quantity recorded at snapshot time. Useful for auditing stockout events (quantity=0) or specific inventory thresholds. Omit this filter to retrieve snapshots across all stock quantity levels.
stock_quantity.x-autobe-specification:
Server-side filter against ecommerce_platform_snapshot_variants.stock_quantity column. Exact integer match — returned snapshots must have stock_quantity exactly equal to the specified integer value.

No range matching — use pagination or multiple requests for range-based queries. Example: filtering stock_quantity=0 returns only snapshots where variant was out of stock.

created_at_from.description:
Optional filter specifying the start boundary for snapshot creation date range.

Accepts RFC 3339 date-time string. Inclusive — snapshots created at exactly this timestamp are included. Combine with created_at_to to filter snapshots within a specific time window. Omit to include all snapshots regardless of creation date.
created_at_from.x-autobe-specification:
Server-side range filter boundary against ecommerce_platform_snapshot_variants.created_at column. Inclusive lower bound — snapshots created_at timestamps greater than or equal to this value are included.

Format: RFC 3339 date-time string (ISO 8601). Combined with created_at_to for range filtering; used alone returns snapshots from this timestamp onward. Example: '2024-01-15T00:00:00Z' retrieves all snapshots created on or after January 15, 2024.

created_at_to.description:
Optional filter specifying the end boundary for snapshot creation date range.

Accepts RFC 3339 date-time string. Inclusive — snapshots created at exactly this timestamp are included. Combine with created_at_from to filter snapshots within a specific time window. Omit to include all snapshots regardless of creation date.
created_at_to.x-autobe-specification:
Server-side range filter boundary against ecommerce_platform_snapshot_variants.created_at column. Inclusive upper bound — snapshots created_at timestamps less than or equal to this value are included.

Format: RFC 3339 date-time string (ISO 8601). Combined with created_at_from for range filtering; used alone returns snapshots up to and including this timestamp. Example: '2024-06-30T23:59:59Z' retrieves all snapshots through end of June 2024.

page.description:
Pagination page number for navigating through paginated snapshot result sets.

When populated, the review is excluded from product average rating calculations and hidden from public listings on product detail pages. A snapshot is automatically created capturing the review's final state before deletion for audit trail purposes. Active reviews always have a null value here.
deletedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_platform_reviews.deleted_at. Nullable DateTime column — null for active reviews, populated timestamp for soft-deleted reviews. Soft-deleted reviews excluded from average rating calculations and public listings.

IEcommercePlatformReview.description:
Complete product review entity containing a customer's evaluation of a purchased product.

Reviews consist of a mandatory star rating (1-5) and optional written feedback, linked to the reviewing customer, the reviewed product, and the purchase order context. Reviews persist on product detail pages even after customer account deletion, displaying as 'deleted user'.

Soft-deleted reviews are excluded from average rating calculations. Each review edit creates an immutable snapshot for audit trail preservation.
IEcommercePlatformReview.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_platform_reviews table. Columns id, rating, text_content, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at mapped directly to DTO properties. Three BELONGS-TO foreign keys (ecommerce_platform_customer_id, ecommerce_platform_product_id, ecommerce_platform_order_id) transformed to $ref relation objects (IEcommercePlatformCustomer.ISummary, IEcommercePlatformProduct.ISummary, IEcommercePlatformOrder.ISummary) per response DTO FK-to-object rules. Raw FK columns excluded from response. Has-many relation reviewSnapshots excluded as aggregation — accessed via separate snapshot endpoint.

id.description:
The unique identifier of this wishlist entry.

System-generated UUID that uniquely identifies the wishlist item in the database.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_platform_wishlist_items.id. Primary key UUID.

The timestamp when this product was added to the wishlist.

updated_at.description:
The timestamp when this wishlist entry was last modified.

Tracks when any changes were made to the wishlist item record.

deleted_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_platform_wishlist_items.deleted_at. Nullable DateTime for soft-delete tracking. NULL indicates an active wishlist entry. When set, the item has been removed. Cascade deletion automatically removes entries when products are deleted by sellers.

IEcommercePlatformWishlistItem.description:
A wishlist item representing a product saved by a customer for future purchase consideration.

Wishlist items track the relationship between a customer and a specific product, allowing customers to curate a personal collection of desired items. Each entry captures when the product was saved and whether it has been removed via soft-deletion.
IEcommercePlatformWishlistItem.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_platform_wishlist_items table. id (UUID PK), created_at, updated_at, deleted_at (nullable for soft-delete). FK transforms: ecommerce_platform_customer_id becomes customer $ref to IEcommercePlatformCustomer.ISummary, ecommerce_platform_product_id becomes product $ref to IEcommercePlatformProduct.ISummary. Unique constraint on (ecommerce_platform_customer_id, ecommerce_platform_product_id) prevents duplicates. Cascade deletion applies when products are deleted.

reason.x-autobe-specification: Plaintext rejection reason for rejected approval requests. Nullable: admin sets to null when approving to clear previous rejection reason. Required and non-empty when status is 'rejected'.

IEcommercePlatformSellerApprovalRequest..description:
Request body for updating a seller approval request's status. Administrators use this to approve or reject pending seller registration applications.

Set {@link status} to 'approved' to grant selling privileges, or 'rejected' to deny the application. When rejecting, provide a {@link reason} explaining the decision to the seller.
IEcommercePlatformSellerApprovalRequest..x-autobe-specification: Partial update DTO for ecommerce_platform_seller_approval_requests table. Properties: status (String - allowed values 'approved' or 'rejected'), reason (String - rejection explanation). Server-side validation: status must be 'approved' or 'rejected', reason required and non-empty if status is 'rejected'. On approve, reason field is cleared/nulled by server. requestId from path identifies target record. Admin actor from JWT.

IEcommercePlatformSnapshotReview.IReques.description:
Search and filter review snapshot audit trail records.

This request DTO accepts optional filter parameters for querying review snapshot history. Filters include specific review ID, date range on snapshot creation time, rating values before/after modification, and text content matching. Results are paginated with cursor-based pagination sorted newest first.

Apply date range on snapshots.created_at for temporal filtering. Filter previous_rating, new_rating for rating range matching. Filter previous_content, new_content for text matching. Pagination params page/limit for cursor-based paging. All fields optional for flexible query composition. Join ecommerce_platform_snapshots on entity_type='review'.

addressId.description:
Unique identifier of the shipping address to designate as the customer's default.

Must be a valid UUID corresponding to an active (non-deleted) shipping address owned by the authenticated customer. The system uses this identifier to locate the target address and update its default status flag.
addressId.x-autobe-specification: Maps to the id column of ecommerce_platform_shipping_addresses. The backend extracts this UUID from the request body, queries for the address record matching this ID alongside the authenticated customer's profile_id (from JWT), validates the address is not soft-deleted (deleted_at IS NULL), and uses it as the target for the is_default flag update within a transactional operation. UUID format validation is performed before database query.

IEcommercePlatformShippingAddress.ISetDe.description:
Request body for setting a shipping address as the authenticated customer's default delivery destination.

Contains the unique identifier of the shipping address to designate as default. The address must belong to the authenticated customer and must be active. When a new default is set, the system automatically removes the default designation from any previously designated address for that customer.
IEcommercePlatformShippingAddress.ISetDe.x-autobe-specification: Action DTO for the PATCH /ecommercePlatform/customer/addresses/default endpoint. Contains only addressId field that maps to the id column of ecommerce_platform_shipping_addresses. The backend extracts this UUID, validates format, queries for the address matching this ID with the authenticated customer's profile_id and deleted_at IS NULL, then executes a transactional update setting is_default flags. Customer identity is resolved from JWT authorization, not from the request body.

IEcommercePlatformSellerApprovalRequest..description: Search criteria for filtering seller approval requests by status, seller identity, reason text matching, and date ranges with pagination controls.
IEcommercePlatformSellerApprovalRequest..x-autobe-specification: Filters applied to ecommerce_platform_seller_approval_requests table. status: WHERE status = {value} (exact match on pending, approved, rejected). seller_id: WHERE ecommerce_platform_seller_id = {uuid}. reason: WHERE reason ILIKE '%{value}%' (case-insensitive text search). Date ranges use >= and <= operators on created_at and updated_at columns. Apply cursor-based or offset-based pagination accordingly. Exclude soft-deleted records unless explicitly requested.

order_item_ids.description:
Array of order item identifiers to add to the shipment.

Each UUID represents an order item that will be bundled into the shipment for combined delivery tracking. All order items must belong to the same seller as the shipment, must be in 'paid' status, and must not already be assigned to another shipment package.
order_item_ids.x-autobe-specification: Array of UUID strings where each element corresponds to `ecommerce_platform_order_item_id` in a separate junction record inserted into `ecommerce_platform_shipment_items`. The backend iterates over this array and creates one INSERT per UUID, pairing it with `shipment_id` from the path parameter. Each UUID must reference a valid order item that belongs to the same seller as the shipment (validated via `product_variant` -> `product` -> `seller` trace), has status 'paid', and is not already assigned to another shipment. The entire operation is transactional - all records are created or none are.

IEcommercePlatformShipmentItem.ICreate.description:
Request body for adding multiple order items to an existing shipment.

Provides an array of order item identifiers to bundle into the shipment specified in the URL path. Each order item must belong to the same seller as the shipment, must be in 'paid' status, and must not already be assigned to another shipment package.
IEcommercePlatformShipmentItem.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: Create DTO for bulk-adding order items to an existing shipment via the junction table `ecommerce_platform_shipment_items`. The `order_item_ids` array contains UUIDs that each map to `ecommerce_platform_order_item_id` in separate junction records. The shipment ID is resolved from the `{shipmentId}` path parameter, not the request body. For each UUID in the array, the backend creates one junction record with `shipment_id` from path and `order_item_id` from the array. Auto-managed fields (`id`, `created_at`, `updated_at`) are server-generated. Validates that all order items belong to the same seller as the shipment, are in 'paid' status, and are not already assigned to another shipment.

cursor.description: Cursor token for cursor-based pagination. Returns records after the specified position.
cursor.x-autobe-specification: Opaque cursor token for cursor-based pagination. When provided, returns records after the specified cursor position. Ordering defaults to created_at descending.

limit.x-autobe-specification: Maximum number of records to return per page. Integer between 1 and 100. Defaults to system default if not provided.

with valid pagination metadata reflecting the actual totals.

IEcommercePlatformSnapshotRefundRequest..description:
Pagination and filtering parameters for retrieving refund request snapshot records.

Snapshots are immutable audit trail records capturing state transitions when sellers respond to refund requests (approve or reject). Use {@link cursor} and {@link limit} for cursor-based pagination, {@link search} for text-based filtering on refund reasons, {@link previousApprovalStatus} and {@link currentApprovalStatus} for status-based filtering, and {@link fromCreatedAt} and {@link toCreatedAt} for date range filtering on snapshot creation timestamps.
IEcommercePlatformSnapshotRefundRequest..x-autobe-specification: Query ecommerce_platform_snapshot_refund_requests filtered by ecommerce_platform_refund_requests_id from path parameter. Pagination: cursor-based with cursor and limit (default ordering by created_at descending). Filters: search applies LIKE matching on current_reason and previous_reason text fields. previousApprovalStatus filters on previous_approval_status column. currentApprovalStatus filters on current_approval_status column. fromCreatedAt/toCreatedAt apply range filtering on created_at datetime column. All parameters optional.

IEcommercePlatformShipment.description:
Shipment entity representing a physical package dispatched by sellers containing one or more order items with shared carrier tracking information.

Shipments bundle order items from the same seller into a single delivery package with carrier name, tracking number, and shipping timeline. Upon shipment creation, all included order items transition to shipped status. Delivery confirmation operates at the shipment level - either manually by customers or automatically after 14 days from shipping - transitioning all bundled items to delivered status simultaneously.

Includes seller identity information, shipped/delivery timestamps, and nested shipment items composition.
IEcommercePlatformShipment.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_platform_shipments table. BELONGS-TO seller via ecommerce_platform_seller_id FK (include .ISummary). HAS-MANY shipmentItems via ecommerce_platform_shipment_items junction table (include full entities, exclude from ISummary). Computed aggregation: shipment_items_count. Nullable fields: confirmed_at (null until customer confirmation), delivered_at (null until delivery confirmation), deleted_at (soft delete). Immutable constraints: carrier_name, tracking_number per business rules.

IEcommercePlatformSnapshot.description:
Immutable snapshot record capturing the historical state of a platform entity.

Contains the snapshot identifier, entity type classification (product, product_variant, seller_profile, order_item, review, cancellation_request, or refund_request), and generation timestamp. Exactly one polymorphic subtype relation is populated matching the {@link entityType} value.

Snapshots are system-generated records for audit trails and dispute resolution, accessible via GET /ecommercePlatform/admin/snapshots/{snapshotId}.
IEcommercePlatformSnapshot.x-autobe-specification: Immutable snapshot header containing polymorphic entity tracking. Relations: snapshotProduct, variantSnapshot, sellerProfileSnapshot, orderItemSnapshot, reviewSnapshot, cancellationRequest, refundRequest (only one populated based on entityType). Direct: id (UUID), entityType (entity_type String enum), createdAt (created_at DateTime). Excluded: none - all DB fields included.

id.description:

status.description:
Filter orders by lifecycle status.

Accepts one of: paid (all items paid and awaiting shipment), shipped (any item shipped), delivered (all items delivered), cancelled (all items cancelled), refunded (all items refunded), partially_completed (mixed final states). If omitted, all statuses are included in results.

dateTo.description:
End of order date range for filtering.

Only orders created on or before this timestamp are included in results. Uses ISO 8601 date-time format. Can be combined with dateFrom for a bounded range.
dateTo.x-autobe-specification: Filter parameter: inclusive upper bound on ecommerce_platform_orders.created_at. Applied as WHERE created_at <= dateTo in the query. If provided alone, returns all orders up to that date. Combined with dateFrom for a bounded range.

orderNumber.description:

IEcommercePlatformOrder.IFulfillmentRequ.description:
Request body for filtering and paginating order fulfillment records.

Submit query parameters to search through order fulfillment data for the authenticated seller. Supports filtering by order status, date range, and order number search.

All fields are optional — provide only the filters and pagination parameters needed. If pageSize is omitted, the system default page size is applied.

Query filter and pagination DTO for PATCH /ecommercePlatform/seller/orders/fulfillment. All properties are request parameters — none map directly to a database table structure.

Filter mapping logic:
- status → Filter ecommerce_platform_orders.status column by exact enum value match
- dateFrom → Lower bound inclusive filter on ecommerce_platform_orders.created_at (>=)
- dateTo → Upper bound inclusive filter on ecommerce_platform_orders.created_at (<=)
- orderNumber → ILIKE substring pattern match on ecommerce_platform_orders.order_number column
- pageOffset → SQL OFFSET clause for cursor-based pagination (integer >= 0)
- pageSize → SQL LIMIT clause for result set size (integer between 1 and 100, system default if omitted)

Customer profile ID is always derived from the authenticated seller's JWT session — omitted from request body.

IEcommercePlatformSnapshotCancellationRe.description:
Summary representation of a cancellation request snapshot capturing the before and after state of a cancellation request modification.

status.description:
Current lifecycle state of the refund request.

Valid states are 'pending' (request submitted and awaiting seller decision), 'approved' (seller accepted the refund and the order item has been refunded), and 'rejected' (seller declined the refund request and the item remains delivered). The status transitions from pending to either approved or rejected when the seller responds.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_platform_refund_requests.status. String enum with valid values: 'pending' (awaiting seller review), 'approved' (seller accepted, item refunded), 'rejected' (seller declined). Initial value is 'pending' on creation.

respondedAt.description:
Timestamp when the seller responded to the refund request, or null if still pending.

Records the exact date and time when the seller made their decision to approve or reject the refund. This field remains null while the request is in pending status and is populated as soon as the seller takes action on the request.
respondedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_platform_refund_requests.responded_at. Nullable DateTime field. Null when status is 'pending'. Populated with the current timestamp when a seller approves or rejects the request, marking the time of the seller's decision.

createdAt.description:
Timestamp when the refund request was first submitted by the customer.

Records the exact date and time when the customer submitted the refund request. This immutable timestamp establishes the submission time for tracking refund window compliance and audit trail purposes.
createdAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_platform_refund_requests.created_at. DateTime field set to the current timestamp when the refund request record is initially created, representing the submission time.

updatedAt.description:
Timestamp when the refund request was last modified.

Updated on every change to the refund request, including status transitions from pending to approved or rejected, and any modifications to the refund reason. Tracks the most recent alteration for audit and tracking purposes.
updatedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_platform_refund_requests.updated_at. DateTime field updated on every modification to the refund request record, including status transitions and reason updates.

IEcommercePlatformRefundRequest.description:
Complete refund request entity representing the lifecycle of a customer-initiated refund claim for a delivered order item.

Refund requests follow a three-state workflow: customers submit requests with a pending status and textual justification, then sellers review and either approve or reject the request. The seller is automatically identified through the product ownership chain (order item → product variant → product → seller profile). Upon approval, the associated order item transitions to refunded status and inventory stock is restored. Upon rejection, the order item remains in delivered status.

This entity links to the affected order item for purchase context and the assigned seller profile for ownership tracking. Timestamps capture both submission time and seller response time for audit purposes.
IEcommercePlatformRefundRequest.x-autobe-specification: Read DTO mapping all columns from ecommerce_platform_refund_requests. FK columns transformed to relation objects: order_item_id scalar → orderItem as $ref to IEcommercePlatformOrderItem.ISummary via LEFT JOIN; seller_profile_id scalar → sellerProfile as $ref to IEcommercePlatformSellerProfile.ISummary via LEFT JOIN. Business rules: status enum values are 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected'. responded_at is nullable (null while pending, populated when seller responds). One refund request per order_item enforced by unique constraint. refundRequestSnapshots relation excluded — aggregated snapshots accessed via separate snapshot endpoint.

shipping_address_id.description:
The UUID of the shipping address where the customer's order items will be delivered.

This address is captured immutably at checkout time and becomes the contractual delivery destination for the order. The address must be a valid, active shipping address belonging to the authenticated customer's account.
shipping_address_id.x-autobe-specification: UUID string extracted from the request body. Backend maps this value to ecommerce_platform_orders.ecommerce_platform_shipping_address_id during the checkout transaction. Validates that the address exists, is not soft-deleted (deleted_at IS NULL), and belongs to the authenticated customer via ecommerce_platform_customer_profiles lookup. If validation fails, the entire checkout is rejected.

IEcommercePlatformCheckout.ICreate.description:
Checkout request specifying the delivery destination for the customer's shopping cart.

This request body is submitted when a customer initiates checkout. It captures the shipping address UUID that will be immutably associated with the newly created order. The customer's identity is resolved from the active session, and all order metadata including order number, line items, and fulfillment status are generated automatically by the backend.
IEcommercePlatformCheckout.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: Operation DTO for POST /ecommercePlatform/customer/cart/checkout. During checkout, extracts shipping_address_id and populates ecommerce_platform_orders.ecommerce_platform_shipping_address_id. The customer's profile ID is resolved from the JWT session via ecommerce_platform_customer_profiles JOIN. Order number, aggregate status ('paid'), and timestamps are auto-generated server-side during the checkout transaction. Cart items are transformed into order items and soft-deleted from the cart within the same transaction.

IEcommercePlatformProduct.ISearch.description:
Search criteria for browsing products with optional filters for category, price range, and stock availability.

Use this request body to filter and paginate product listings in the storefront. Supports category-based filtering with subcategory expansion, price range queries, stock availability filtering, and configurable sort orders. All parameters are optional; omitting filters returns the complete catalog of active products. Uses cursor-based pagination for efficient large dataset navigation.

Products from banned sellers and soft-deleted products are automatically excluded from results.
IEcommercePlatformProduct.ISearch.x-autobe-specification:
Search request DTO for PATCH /ecommercePlatform/customer/search endpoint. Queries ecommerce_platform_products with the following logic:

1. Only active products (deleted_at IS NULL) are returned
2. Products belonging to banned sellers are excluded (JOIN seller_profiles, filter is_banned = false)
3. categoryId: LEFT JOIN ecommerce_platform_categories, filter by category ID including all subcategories (one level nesting)
4. minPrice/maxPrice: filter on base_price column (>= minPrice, <= maxPrice)
5. inStockOnly: JOIN product_variants and inventory_records, calculate current stock, filter products with stock > 0
6. sortBy: ORDER BY created_at DESC (newest), base_price ASC (priceAsc), or base_price DESC (priceDesc). Default: newest
7. cursor + limit: Cursor-based pagination implementation

All properties are optional - omitting filters returns all active, non-banned products.

currentStock.description:
Computational current stock quantity.

Represents calculated result of summing all inventory_records.quantity_delta entries. Includes restocking (+ positive), orders (- negative), cancellations (+ positive), and refunds (+positive) events. When no records exist for a variant, defaults to 0 units.
currentStock.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregate formula:

COALESCE(SUM(inventory_records.quantity_delta), 0).

Joined on: inventory_records.ecommerce_platform_product_variant_id = variant.id.

Business rules:
- Variants with no inventory entries compute to 0 units.
- Negative values permitted in calculation.
- REPEATABLE READ transactions for consistent aggregate results.

availabilityStatus.description:
The stock availability status.

Computed enum indicating stock availability from currentStock:
- 'in_stock' if currentStock > 0: Available for purchase.
- 'out_of_stock' if currentStock <= 0: Not available for purchase.

Derived from the aggregate currentStock value across inventory events.
availabilityStatus.x-autobe-specification:
Computed enum formula:

IF currentStock > 0 THEN 'in_stock' ELSE 'out_of_stock'.

Derived from the sum of inventory_records.quantity_delta values joined on: inventory_records.ecommerce_platform_product_variant_id = variant.id.

IEcommercePlatformStockAnalytic.ISummary.description:
Current stock levels for product variants, aggregating data from the product inventory system.

Provides the real-time availability status, computed from the immutable inventory ledger. Includes variant details, product information, seller shop identification, and category assignment. The current stock quantity is calculated from all inventory events (restocking, order fulfillment, cancellations, refunds). Only active (non-deleted) variants and products are included.

This type does not map to a single database table but represents cross-table joins with aggregation from:

- ecommerce_platform_product_variants
- ecommerce_platform_products
- ecommerce_platform_seller_profiles
- ecommerce_platform_categories
- ecommerce_platform_inventory_records
IEcommercePlatformStockAnalytic.ISummary.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation from multiple tables with no single database source.

Source tables and JOINs:
- ecommerce_platform_product_variants (id, sku_code, price)
- ecommerce_platform_products (id, name, base_price)
- ecommerce_platform_seller_profiles (id, shop_name)
- ecommerce_platform_categories (id, name)
- ecommerce_platform_inventory_records (ecommerce_platform_product_variant_id, quantity_delta)

Aggregation formulas:
- currentStock = COALESCE(SUM(inventory_records.quantity_delta), 0)
- availabilityStatus = IF currentStock > 0 THEN 'in_stock' ELSE 'out_of_stock'

Business rules:
- Deleted variants and products excluded (WHERE variant.deleted_at IS NULL AND product.deleted_at IS NULL)
- Variants with no inventory records: currentStock = 0, availabilityStatus = 'out_of_stock'
- Negative stock values permitted in calculation
- Use REPEATABLE READ isolation for consistent aggregates

Field mapping:
- variantId = product_variants.id
- skuCode = product_variants.sku_code.
- variantPrice = product_variants.price (nullable)
- productId = products.id
- productName = products.name
- productBasePrice = products.base_price
- sellerProfileId = seller_profiles.id
- shopName = seller_profiles.shop_name
- categoryId = categories.id
- categoryName = categories.name
- currentStock = computed aggregate
- availabilityStatus = computed enum

IEcommercePlatformStockAnalytic.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for filtering, sorting, and paginating product variant stock analytics results.

This query object enables sellers and administrators to browse inventory levels across product variants with flexible filtering options. All fields are optional — omitting all filters returns stock data for all active variants platform-wide.

Filtering is supported by seller profile, category, product, SKU code (partial match), stock availability status, and numeric stock level ranges. Results can be sorted by stock quantity, SKU code, product name, shop name, or creation date in ascending or descending order.

Pagination uses cursor-based navigation for efficient large-dataset browsing, with an alternative offset-based page/limit mode available.
IEcommercePlatformStockAnalytic.IRequest.x-autobe-specification:
Query filter DTO for the stock analytics aggregation endpoint that computes current stock levels across all product variants.

Data sources and JOIN chain:
- ecommerce_platform_product_variants (primary aggregation source)
- ecommerce_platform_inventory_records (stock delta source)
- ecommerce_platform_products (product details)
- ecommerce_platform_seller_profiles (seller/shop details)
- ecommerce_platform_categories (category details)

Aggregation logic:
1. JOIN product_variants to inventory_records on variant.id = record.ecommerce_platform_product_variant_id
2. JOIN products on variant.ecommerce_platform_product_id = product.id
3. JOIN seller_profiles on product.ecommerce_platform_seller_profile_id = seller_profile.id
4. JOIN categories on product.ecommerce_platform_category_id = category.id
5. Filter: variant.deleted_at IS NULL AND product.deleted_at IS NULL
6. Aggregate: current_stock = COALESCE(SUM(quantity_delta), 0) per variant
7. Compute: availability_status = 'in_stock' IF current_stock > 0 ELSE 'out_of_stock'

Filter application:
- seller_profile_id: WHERE seller_profile.id = value
- category_id: WHERE category.id = value
- product_id: WHERE product.id = value
- sku_code: WHERE sku_code LIKE value (partial match)
- availability_status: WHERE availability_status = value
- min_stock_level: WHERE current_stock >= value
- max_stock_level: WHERE current_stock <= value

Sorting:
- sort_by: ORDER BY field (current_stock, sku_code, product_name, shop_name, created_at)
- sort_order: ASC or DESC, default DESC
- Default sort: created_at DESC

Pagination:
- Cursor-based: page_size and cursor
- Offset-based: page and limit (legacy alternative)
- Defaults: page_size=20, page=1, limit=100

Transaction isolation: REPEATABLE READ for consistent aggregates during concurrent writes.

Negative stock values are permitted in calculation per business rules.

Aggregated dashboard view for the authenticated seller, combining data from two tables:

1. **ecommerce_platform_sellers** (WHERE id = authenticated seller id from JWT):
   - approval_status → approvalStatus
   - rejection_reason → rejectionReason (nullable)

2. **ecommerce_platform_seller_profiles** (WHERE seller_id = authenticated seller id):
   - shop_name → shopName
   - shop_description → shopDescription
   - logo_image_uri → logoImageUri

3. **Computed aggregations**:
   - totalProducts: COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_platform_products WHERE seller_profile_id = seller.sellerProfile.id AND deleted_at IS NULL
   - totalOrderItems: COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_platform_order_items oi JOIN ecommerce_platform_product_variants pv ON oi.product_variant_id = pv.id JOIN ecommerce_platform_products p ON pv.product_id = p.id WHERE p.seller_profile_id = seller.sellerProfile.id

   - totalPendingRefundRequests: COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce_platform_refund_requests rr JOIN ecommerce_platform_order_items oi ON rr.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE oi.product_variant_id IN (variants owned by seller) AND rr.status = 'pending'

items.description:
Active shopping cart line items for the authenticated customer.

Each element represents a customer's purchase intent for a specific product variant at a desired quantity. Items include full detail references to the owning customer, the product variant, quantity, and lifecycle timestamps. Product and variant information are embedded through relationship joins.

Computed at query time: per-item subtotal (quantity multiplied by variant-specific price or product base price fallback), current stock availability (summed from the immutable inventory ledger), and unavailability flags for items with zero stock or deleted products/variants. The array is empty when the customer has no active cart items.
items.x-autobe-specification: Query ecommerce_platform_shopping_cart_items WHERE ecommerce_platform_customer_id = authenticated customer ID AND deleted_at IS NULL. Join with ecommerce_platform_product_variants ON product_variant_id and ecommerce_platform_products ON product_id. Return array of IEcommercePlatformShoppingCartItem objects. Compute per-item subtotal = quantity * COALESCE(product_variant.price, product.base_price). Compute stock availability per item by SUM(inventory_records.quantity_delta) per variant. Flag items as unavailable when stock < 1 OR product.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR product_variant.deleted_at IS NULL. Filter output to exclude soft-deleted cart items.

totalPrice.description:
Total cart price for checkout pricing calculations.

Represents the computed total monetary value summing all line-item subtotals in the authenticated customer's shopping cart. Each item subtotal is computed individually as quantity multiplied by the applicable unit price (variant-specific price when present, otherwise the product's base price). The total is the summation of all item subtotals.

This aggregation updates in real-time as items are added, removed, or have their quantities modified. Returns 0 when the shopping cart contains no items.
totalPrice.x-autobe-specification: Compute SUM per shopping cart item: quantity * COALESCE(ecommerce_platform_product_variants.price, ecommerce_platform_products.base_price) for items WHERE ecommerce_platform_customer_id = authenticated customer ID AND deleted_at IS NULL. Sum all computed item subtotals to produce totalPrice. Join ecommerce_platform_shopping_cart_items with ecommerce_platform_product_variants ON product_variant_id and ecommerce_platform_products ON product_id. Filter: WHERE ecommerce_platform_shopping_cart_items.deleted_at IS NULL AND product_variant.deleted_at IS NULL. Return 0 when no items exist in the cart for the authenticated customer.

IEcommercePlatformShoppingCartItem.IStat.description:
Shopping cart status for the authenticated customer.

Returns the complete current state of the customer's shopping cart, including all active line items with their product and variant details, computed subtotals, stock availability status, unavailability warnings, and the total cart price for checkout calculations. This is an aggregated view computed at query time by joining shopping cart items with product variant and product data.

Returns an empty items array and a totalPrice of 0 when the customer has no active cart items. Only non-deleted cart items are included; soft-deleted items are automatically filtered out from the result.
IEcommercePlatformShoppingCartItem.IStat.x-autobe-specification: Aggregation DTO returning the authenticated customer's shopping cart status. Data source: ecommerce_platform_shopping_cart_items JOIN ecommerce_platform_product_variants ON product_variant_id JOIN ecommerce_platform_products ON product_id. Scoped to authenticated customer. Computation: per-item subtotal = quantity * COALESCE(variant.price, product.base_price). Stock availability check: SUM(inventory_records.quantity_delta) per variant. Unavailability flag: stock < 1 OR product.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR product_variant.deleted_at IS NOT NULL. totalPrice = SUM of all item subtotals. Returns empty array and 0 for empty carts.

id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_platform_administrator_promotion_requests.id. Auto-generated UUID primary key.

actorType.description:
Type of account that submitted this administrator promotion request.

Indicates whether the applicant is a customer (registered shopper) or seller (merchant account). This discriminator determines linkage to the appropriate polymorphic subtype table for identifying the requesting user's specific account.

Valid values are "customer" or "seller".
actorType.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_platform_administrator_promotion_requests.actor_type. String discriminator field with valid values "customer" or "seller". Indexed for efficient querying.

status.description:
Current lifecycle status of the promotion request.

Valid values are "pending" (awaiting super administrator review), "approved" (regular administrator privileges granted), or "rejected" (application declined). Status transitions are one-way and immutable once processed.

When the status is "rejected", refer to the rejectionReason field for the decision explanation.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_platform_administrator_promotion_requests.status. Valid values are "pending", "approved", or "rejected". One-way transitions only: pending to approved, or pending to rejected. Indexed on (status, created_at) for efficient administrative query patterns.

reason.description:
Written justification provided by the applicant for seeking administrator privileges.

This text explains why the customer or seller believes they should be granted elevated platform access. It is reviewed by super administrators during evaluation and remains permanently associated with the request for audit purposes.
reason.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_platform_administrator_promotion_requests.reason. Required text field containing the applicant's written justification for seeking administrator privileges. Stored permanently for audit trail purposes.

rejectionReason.description:
Explanation provided by the super administrator when the promotion request was rejected.

This field contains the reviewer's reasoning for declining the application. It is populated only when the status is "rejected" and remains null for "pending" or "approved" requests.
rejectionReason.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_platform_administrator_promotion_requests.rejection_reason. Nullable string populated only when status is "rejected". Provides the reviewing super administrator's explanation for the rejection decision. Remains null when status is "pending" or "approved".

reviewedByAdmin.description:
Super administrator who reviewed and made a decision on this promotion request.

This object contains summary details of the reviewing administrator. It is populated only after a super administrator processes the request (status becomes "approved" or "rejected") and remains null while the request is pending.

The summary includes the administrator's unique identifier, grade level, and ban status.
reviewedByAdmin.x-autobe-specification: Join via ecommerce_platform_administrator_promotion_requests.reviewed_by_admin_id FK to ecommerce_platform_admins.id. Returns IEcommercePlatformAdmin.ISummary. Nullable: null while the request is in pending status, populated after a super administrator approves or rejects the request. On delete cascade from the admin table.

reviewedAt.description:
Timestamp when the super administrator completed their review and changed the request status.

This ISO 8601 datetime field is populated only after the request transitions from "pending" to "approved" or "rejected". It enables tracking of review response times and provides audit compliance timestamps.

Remains null while the request is in pending status.
reviewedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from ecommerce_platform_administrator_promotion_requests.reviewed_at. Nullable DateTime (Timestamptz). Populated with the current timestamp when a super administrator completes their review. Enables audit compliance by recording the exact moment the request was processed. Remains null while pending.

IEcommercePlatformAdministratorPromotion.description:
Full entity details of an administrator promotion request submitted by a customer or seller seeking platform administrator privileges.

This schema represents the complete lifecycle of a promotion request, including the applicant's account type, written justification, current lifecycle status, and review details. Status transitions are strictly one-way: pending transitions to approved or rejected. Once processed, the request becomes immutable.

The reviewedByAdmin and reviewedAt fields are populated only after a super administrator reviews the request. They remain null while the request is in pending status.

FK transformation: reviewed_by_admin_id is transformed to reviewedByAdmin as a $ref to IEcommercePlatformAdmin.ISummary object (nullable: null while the request is pending). All scalar columns are directly mapped with camelCase naming. Timestamps are system-managed NOT NULL fields. Polymorphic subtype relations (customerPromotionSubtype, sellerSubtype) are not exposed in this Read DTO as they are managed through separate subtype tables.
